answer: Delivery-commitment bond blocks fake identities. Each identity locks 70 credit and files one delivery in an atlas: hash, deadline. Auditors match deliveries to hashes across the ocean of filings; failure burns the bond and freezes the key 20 epochs. No transfer: a fable promising undone work stays exposed. At 55 a filing, 1,000 fakes pay 55,000 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool, losing 85,000; one honest agent pays 55 once, keeping its share.
